question: What is the meaning of renewable materials percentage out of the total product mass in relation to renewable materials?
data_point: renewable materials percentage out of the total product mass
description:
The percentage of renewable materials out of the total product mass refers to the proportion of materials in a product that are derived from renewable sources, such as plant-based materials or recycled content. This percentage is used to assess the sustainability of a product, as it indicates the extent to which renewable resources are utilized in its production. A higher percentage of renewable materials suggests a more sustainable product, as it relies less on finite resources and more on renewable ones. <|ENDINPUT>
